title: Witch on Stormy Dock
description: A pink-haired witch in ornate dark robes stands on a stormy wooden dock, holding a glowing jack-o'-lantern staff. She is surrounded by floating ghosts, glowing pumpkins, and magical teal energy swirls as lightning strikes a dark gothic tower and shipwreck in the turbulent sea under a swirling cloudy sky.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene of a powerful witch with long flowing pink hair standing on a rickety wooden dock over a stormy ocean at night. She wears ornate dark robes and holds a tall staff topped with a glowing carved pumpkin. Floating around her are multiple translucent white and blue ghosts and several glowing jack-o'-lanterns. In the background a gothic tower and broken ship masts rise from the turbulent waves under a dramatic sky filled with swirling storm clouds, green lightning, and teal energy swirls.
